aggressive_definition_excerpt: An inverse association was seen for daidzein overall (odds ratio for the highest vs lowest quintile=0.55, 95% confidence interval=0.31-0.98, P(trend)=0.03) and seemed to apply to localized (P(trend)=0.08) as well as advanced or high-grade cancer (P(trend)=0.09).
study_design: Nested case-control study within a multiethnic cohort
reason: The abstract analyzes overall incident prostate cancer and separately evaluates localized and advanced or high-grade cancer. It does not report the number of aggressive cases.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: Urine samples were analysed for daidzein, genistein, equol, and enterolactone among 249 incident prostate cancer cases and 404 controls matched on age, race/ethnicity, date/time of specimen collection, and fasting status.
estimate_classifications.reason: The supplied genistein estimate is for overall incident prostate cancer. The abstract establishes the general incident endpoint, although its numeric genistein estimate comes from the supplied full-text evidence.

validation_findings: Nested case-control/case-cohort analytic denominator must not be forced to full-cohort N
